recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The source now preserves the approved FHIR-40497 clarification while correcting the malformed markup introduced during initial application.
issue_request: FHIR-40497 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core-http section 3.2.0.3 vread. The final decision was to replace the generic HEAD note with wording that says HEAD can test whether a specific version exists and provide access to headers such as ETag, rather than retrieve the version id.
initial_application: Git commit 3acb6e19b20a30c0d7c8ad3d307bd537435eacbd, later noted in Jira as PR #3442, applied the substantive vread wording in source/http.html. That application introduced malformed HTML as ETag>, leaving an extra rendered greater-than sign.
additional_context: FHIR-39135 was the broader published http.html editorial issue whose comments asked for a separate tracker for the vread HEAD sentence; FHIR-40496 was an adjacent but separate capabilities/MIME-type tracker decided in the same FHIR-I minutes. The 2024-12-09 FHIR-I minutes confirm that HEAD should be described as determining whether a version exists, not as retrieving the version id. No Zulip discussion was found that conflicts with the Jira and Confluence record.
reconciliation: Edited source/http.html, the current FHIR-core HTTP page source, to remove the stray greater-than sign after the ETag code element and remove trailing whitespace from the preceding line. No other HEAD notes were changed because the Jira scope was vread-specific.
source_changes: source/http.html: removed the extra greater-than sign after the ETag code element and trailing whitespace in the vread HEAD note.
